description: Create a new matter (name required; pass clientId to attach a client contact). visibility decides who can see it: all_members reaches every internal member without an assignment (never external users); admins_and_assigned reaches owners, admins and the assigned members; assigned_only reaches only the assigned members. Without visibility, a matter with a client is admins_and_assigned and one without a client is personal: assigned_only, visible only to its creator. The creator becomes the matter lead. Returns the matter ID.

clientId.description: Contact ID to attach in the client role

visibility.description: Who can see the matter: all_members (every internal member), admins_and_assigned (owners, admins and assigned members) or assigned_only (assigned members only). Defaults to assigned_only (only assigned members; the creator leads) for a matter without a client, and to admins_and_assigned for a client matter.
